j K) atTop ≤ μ K) → μ {x | f x = t} = 0 → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂(μs j)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξX x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μX))) → ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Xs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ξs : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (μs' : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ξs' : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P d) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ' : Euclid GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → Continuous f → WeaklyConvergesOn Xs X → (∀ j, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μs j K < ∞) → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (ξs j) (μs j)) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μs j), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξs j x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ j, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), Xs j ω = ∫ x, ξs j x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂(μs j)) → (∀ j, ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μs' j K < ∞) → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (ξs' j) (μs' j)) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μs' j), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξs' j x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ j, ∀ η : TestFormOn U d, (Xs j).boundary η = ∫ x, ξs' j x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂(μs' j)) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U d, X.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm ∂(μs' j)) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → WeaklyConvergesOn (fun j => (As j).boundary - Bs j) (A.boundary - B)
